CellWarningResponse.description: A cell that could not be converted to its field's type; the value became null.
CellWarningResponse.title: CellWarningResponse

ChangeRoleRequest.description: Body of PATCH /users/{id}: the user's new role.
ChangeRoleRequest.title: ChangeRoleRequest

ChooseProfileRequest.description: Body of PUT /imports/{id}/profile: the source profile and the default country (D-078).
ChooseProfileRequest.title: ChooseProfileRequest

CreateUserRequest.description: Body of POST /users: the new user's email, role and the admin-set initial password.
CreateUserRequest.title: CreateUserRequest

DuplicateFileResponse.description:
Body of the 409 warning for a file that was already uploaded (D-109).

The client shows the earlier date and user and offers "cancel" or "import anyway"; the
latter means uploading the same file again with allow_duplicate=true.
DuplicateFileResponse.title: DuplicateFileResponse

ErrorResponse.description: Body of a 401 or 403: one fixed message, nothing about the user, owner or capability.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

EstimateResponse.description: What the file itself shows before the import starts (no match or duplicate numbers).
EstimateResponse.title: EstimateResponse

ImportFileResponse.description: An import as shown in status calls (no storage key, no server path).
ImportFileResponse.title: ImportFileResponse

ImportProgressResponse.description:
How far an import is: status, rows handled so far and the outcome counters (D-050).

Before the import starts every counter is 0. received counts rows already committed, so
percent (received out of row_count) only moves forward, also after a worker restart.
ImportProgressResponse.title: ImportProgressResponse

ImportStatus.description: Lifecycle of an uploaded import file.
ImportStatus.title: ImportStatus

LoginRequest.description: Body of POST /auth/login. Unknown fields are rejected.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

MappingColumnResponse.description: One file column with its mapping; origin says where a suggestion came from.
MappingColumnResponse.title: MappingColumnResponse

MappingEntry.description: One column's chosen target; null ignores the column (it stays in the raw rows).
MappingEntry.title: MappingEntry

MappingErrorResponse.description: Body of a refused mapping step: a fixed message and a stable machine-readable code.
MappingErrorResponse.title: MappingErrorResponse

MappingResponse.description: The mapping step: columns, whether they are saved, suggestions and what blocks start.
MappingResponse.title: MappingResponse

PreviewResponse.description: The first rows of the file as the saved mapping reads them.
PreviewResponse.title: PreviewResponse

PreviewRowResponse.description: One previewed row: its sheet position and the mapped values the pipeline would receive.
PreviewRowResponse.title: PreviewRowResponse

ProfileDefaultsResponse.description: Result of saving a mapping as a profile's defaults.
ProfileDefaultsResponse.title: ProfileDefaultsResponse

ProfileOptionResponse.description: A source profile the uploader may choose (no saved mapping content is exposed).
ProfileOptionResponse.title: ProfileOptionResponse

ProfileSuggestionResponse.description: A profile whose saved headers match the file; only a suggestion, the user confirms.
ProfileSuggestionResponse.title: ProfileSuggestionResponse

SaveMappingRequest.description: Body of PUT /imports/{id}/mapping; columns not listed are ignored.
SaveMappingRequest.title: SaveMappingRequest

SessionUserResponse.description:
The signed-in user plus the CSRF token of the current session (login and /auth/me).

The frontend keeps the token in memory and sends it as X-CSRF-Token on every POST, PUT,
PATCH and DELETE except login (A8).
SessionUserResponse.title: SessionUserResponse

TargetFieldResponse.description: One canonical field a column can be mapped to (from the registry in leads.contracts).
TargetFieldResponse.title: TargetFieldResponse

UnmappedColumnResponse.description: A file column that maps to no field (kept in the raw rows only).
UnmappedColumnResponse.title: UnmappedColumnResponse

UploadErrorResponse.description: Body of a refused upload: a fixed message and a stable machine-readable code.
UploadErrorResponse.title: UploadErrorResponse

UploadResponse.description:
The result of an upload: the import plus what the file contains.

worksheets lists every sheet of an XLSX file (empty for CSV). When worksheet is null the
file has several sheets and the user must pick one with POST /imports/{id}/worksheet.
headers is set once a sheet is known (CSV, or a one-sheet XLSX), else null.
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

UserDetailResponse.description:
A user as shown on the admin user list and "my profile": adds status and timestamps.

Never includes the password hash.
UserDetailResponse.title: UserDetailResponse

UserRole.description: Roles a user can hold; the lowercase value is what PostgreSQL stores.
UserRole.title: UserRole

ValidationErrorItem.description: One rejected field in a 422: where it was, why, and the error type; never the value.
ValidationErrorItem.title: ValidationErrorItem

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Body of a 422, exactly as core.errors.validation_error_handler returns it.
ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse

WorksheetResponse.description: One worksheet of an XLSX upload; selectable sheets can be chosen for the import.
WorksheetResponse.title: WorksheetResponse

post.description:
Upload a CSV or XLSX file (multipart: 'file' and optional 'allow_duplicate').

A file identical to an earlier upload gets a 409 warning with the earlier date and user;
re-upload with allow_duplicate=true to import it anyway (D-109). Nothing is stored for a
refused upload. A multi-sheet XLSX returns its worksheets and needs
POST /imports/{id}/worksheet before the import can continue.
